trial_title: Assessment of Carotid Artery Stenosis and Lower Limb Peripheral Ischemia Prior to CABG
brief_summary: From our experience among Egyptian population in our institution, there is an increased prevalence of hidden subclinical peripheral artery disease along with carotid artery affection.
